top_signals.title: Vietnam Plans Index Options for Next Year After FTSE Upgrade
top_signals.summary: Vietnam aims to introduce stock index options in the first quarter of next year as the country seeks to deepen its capital markets and attract more overseas investors following an upgrade to its equity market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
